events.name: Enamelling Workshop for Visually Impaired Young People
events.description: Hands-on enamelling workshop with Gifted Crafts for visually impaired young people aged 14–25. Participants can learn to fuse glass powders onto metal; friends and family members are welcome. Places are limited.

events.name: Village Halls and Community Buildings Conference 2026 – Telford & Wrekin
events.description: Community Resource conference for people who run village halls or community buildings, and those interested in its membership network. Includes practical advice, volunteer recruitment and support, ACT awareness, Community Connectors updates, training opportunities and networking.

events.name: Telford & Shropshire LVEP Tourism Trade Event Series launch – National Trust Ironbridge Gorge
events.description: Launch of the Telford & Shropshire LVEP Tourism Trade Event Series, focused on National Trust Ironbridge Gorge. Tourism businesses can hear about the evolving visitor offer, future opportunities and wider visitor-economy activity, with networking and Q&A.

events.name: Suicide Prevention in our Communities
events.description: Free Shropshire Council suicide-prevention awareness training covering myths and stigma, recognising signs and risk factors, conversations and signposting, safety planning and self-care. Intended for new Orange Button recruits and eligible teams or individuals with reach to higher-risk communities.

events.name: Titty Trail Shropshire 2026
events.description: A 10.5-mile charity trail around Ironbridge raising awareness of breast-cancer signs and screening while supporting local cancer services. Trail-run, guided-walk and self-guided options are available. Registration is 08:00–08:45 and the trail starts at 09:00.
events.parking_transport: Very limited parking at Coalbrookdale Community Centre. Official event Park & Ride operates from Ironbridge P&R at Jiggers Bank (TF4 3XH), £2 return, with outward buses 08:00–08:40 and return service 11:00–16:00.
events.age_guidance: Children must be 11+ and accompanied by an appropriate adult

events.name: Bonfire and Firework Spectacular 2026 – West Mid Showground
events.description: West Mid Showground's annual Bonfire and Firework Spectacular, with two displays: a reduced-noise display at 18:15 and a louder display at 19:45. Proceeds support the Shropshire & West Midlands Agricultural Society's Rural Charity.
events.source_name: West Mid Showground / Shropshire & West Midlands Agricultural Society

events.name: Mayor's Charity Night – Wellington
events.description: Charity curry night hosted by Wellington Mayor Cllr Reg Snell in support of the Harry Johnson Trust and KIP. The official Town Council listing confirms the date, 7pm start and venue; it does not state a price, end time or booking requirement.

events.name: Made in Shropshire Artisan Fair – Dudmaston Hall
events.description: Made in Shropshire and the National Trust co-host an artisan fair with approximately 30 local art, craft and food stalls at Dudmaston Hall. The event itself is free; normal property admission applies and National Trust members enter free.

events.name: Museum Ghost Tour 2026 – 30 October
events.description: Halloween ghost tour through Shrewsbury Museum & Art Gallery's creepy cellars and prison cells, normally closed to the public. Tour starts outside the Museum at 18:00. Adult tickets £17; child tickets £8 for ages 10–17. Suitable for ages 10+.
events.accessibility: Uneven and steep steps and some low ceilings; suitable footwear advised.

events.name: My backgarden and beyond – Steve Dawes
events.description: Illustrated wildlife talk with photographer and naturalist Steve Dawes, exploring wildlife found in gardens and the wider countryside. Hosted by the Bridgnorth Branch of Shropshire Wildlife Trust.

events.name: Museum Ghost Tour 2026 – 31 October
events.description: Halloween ghost tour through Shrewsbury Museum & Art Gallery's creepy cellars and prison cells, normally closed to the public. Tour starts outside the Museum at 18:00. Adult tickets £17; child tickets £8 for ages 10–17. Suitable for ages 10+.
events.accessibility: Uneven and steep steps and some low ceilings; suitable footwear advised.

events.name: Bomere Heath Cricket Club Annual Bonfire Night 2026
events.description: Village Bonfire Night at Bomere Heath Cricket Club. Gates open 4:30pm, bar opens 5:00pm, bonfire is lit at 6:00pm and fireworks are from 7:00pm. Current early-bird tickets: adults 17+ £8 plus booking fee; ages 6–16 £3 plus booking fee; under-6s free.
events.accessibility: Limited accessibility facilities are available due to the nature of the event; contact the organiser in advance if required.
events.parking_transport: Limited parking is available weather permitting and may be reduced or cancelled if the field is affected by poor weather. Walking or car sharing is encouraged.
events.age_guidance: All ages; children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: Spooktacular Soiree for Severn Hospice – Albright Hussey Manor
events.description: Halloween Spooktacular Soiree at Albright Hussey Manor in aid of Severn Hospice, with a three-course Haunted Hussey meal and evening entertainment. The venue states £45 per person, or £40 per person for tables of 10 or more, with a £10 per-person deposit required to confirm a booking.

events.name: Family Ceilidh with Join the Dots
events.description: Family ceilidh with Join the Dots at Clun Memorial Hall. Doors open at 6:00pm and the event starts at 6:30pm. General admission is £12 plus booking fee; age 15 and under is free. A bar will be available.
events.parking_transport: Clun Memorial Hall states its car park holds approximately 60 cars, with possible overflow if needed.
events.source_name: Clun Memorial Hall & Playing Fields Charity / WeGotTickets
events.age_guidance: All ages; under-14s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: Transglobal Underground play StMs
events.description: Transglobal Underground perform at StMs.Presents in Sheriffhales. The organiser-added ticket listing gives doors at 7:00pm, performance start at 7:30pm and the event running until 11:00pm.

events.name: Little Glow Sensory Room – Stirchley – 28 Sep
events.description: Calm, parent-led sensory room for babies from birth to pre-walking, with fibre-optic lights, bubble lamps and gentle music. Small, relaxed session with no set activities. This recurring Monday activity is also confirmed for 5 and 12 October at £6.50, with Halloween editions on 19 and 26 October at £7.50; 26 October is currently sold out/waitlist.
events.accessibility: Designed as a gentle, low-stimulation environment. The organiser describes its classes generally as SEND-friendly; contact the organiser for individual adjustment needs.

events.name: Little Glow Sensory Room – Stirchley – 5 Oct
events.description: Recurring calm, parent-led sensory room for babies from birth to pre-walking. Small, relaxed and low-stimulation, with fibre-optic lights, bubble lamps and gentle music. events.accessibility: Designed as a gentle, low-stimulation environment. The organiser describes its classes generally as SEND-friendly; contact the organiser for individual adjustment needs.

events.name: Kinship Telford Live Well Hub Drop-in – Wellington
events.description: Informal Kinship Telford drop-in to meet members of the Kinship Team, learn about the Kinship Local Offer and available support, collect information and ask questions. The official source does not state a price or booking requirement.

events.description: Informal Kinship Telford drop-in to meet members of the Kinship Team, learn about the Kinship Local Offer and available support, collect information and ask questions. The official source does not state a price or booking requirement.

events.name: Little Glow Halloween Sensory Room – Stirchley – 19 Oct
events.description: Halloween edition of the calm Little Glow sensory room for birth-to-pre-walking babies and grown-ups. Gentle glowing pumpkins, lights, projections and soft music; designed to feel magical rather than scary. Fancy dress optional. A second Halloween session on 26 October is confirmed but currently sold out/waitlist.
events.accessibility: Small, gentle and low-stimulation session. The organiser describes its classes generally as SEND-friendly; contact the organiser for individual adjustment needs.

events.name: Little Mess – Fangtastic Mess – Lawley
events.description: Low-cost Halloween messy/sensory play session for children aged 6 months to 5 years. The direct organiser listing confirms Sunday 25 October, 9:30–10:30am, £4–£9.50 and spaces available.
events.accessibility: The organiser describes its Telford classes generally as SEND-friendly; contact the organiser for event-specific adjustments or allergy requirements.
